plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Perform comprehensive code review for security, performance, and architecture. Save reviews to file, fix issues via /fix-report (paginated) or /fix-all (bulk, then offers to resolve needs-decision findings, optional severity floor). Persist PR review feedback via /analyze-feedback. Optional verification phase for cross-analysis and adversarial review.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Generate meaningful commit messages and block force-push while guarding pushes to protected branches

plugins.name: frontend-developer
plugins.description: Enforces TypeScript + React best practices, coding standards, TDD workflow, and modern tooling (Tailwind, Zustand, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, TanStack Router)

plugins.name: php-developer
plugins.description: Enforces PHP best practices, coding standards, TDD workflow, and modern tooling for Symfony, Doctrine ORM, and DDD projects

plugins.name: python-developer
plugins.description: Master the Python programming language for efficient and effective development

plugins.name: web-auditor
plugins.description: Comprehensive web audit with multi-agent architecture covering security, SEO, performance, and compliance. Optional verification phase for cross-domain correlation and adversarial review.

plugins.name: security-pipeline
plugins.description: Generate and merge security scanning steps (Semgrep SAST + TruffleHog) into CI/CD pipeline configurations across Bitbucket, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Azure DevOps

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Automated QA testing plugin — analyzes code changes, generates test plans, executes FE and BE tests, and self-drives a test→fix→retest loop (`/qa:loop` generates a plan when none exists). Reports compatible with code-review.

plugins.name: superutils
plugins.description: Companion utilities for the superpowers workflow — loop-engineered verification of design specs.

plugins.name: sequentialthinking
plugins.description: An MCP server implementation that provides a tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through a structured thinking process.
